---
title: "Neu_pooling cluster-level"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
dat_neu <- openesm::get_dataset("0001_fried")$data[, c("id", 
"scheduled", "issued", "response", "difficulties_relaxing", "irritable", "worry", "nervous")]

head(dat_neu)
```

```{r}
dat_neu <- dplyr::rename(dat_neu,
              neu.1 = difficulties_relaxing,
              neu.2 = irritable,
              neu.3 = worry,
              neu.4 = nervous)
```

```{r}
dat_neu$neu <- rowMeans(
  dat_neu[, c("neu.1","neu.2","neu.3","neu.4")],
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(clustinvar)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
model <- '
level: 1
fw =~ neu.1 + neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4

level:2
neu.1 ~~ neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4
neu.2 ~~ neu.3 + neu.4
neu.3 ~~ neu.4
'

items <- c("neu.1", "neu.2", "neu.3", "neu.4")

fit <- cfa(
  model,
  data = dat_neu,
  cluster = "id",
  estimator = "MLR",
  missing = "FIML"
)
modindices(fit, sort = TRUE, min = 3.84)
```

```{r}
config_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit_measures = c("chisq.scaled", "rmsea.robust", "cfi.robust", "srmr"),
  constraint = "none",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE,
  likelihood = "normal",
  return_lavaan = TRUE
)

saveRDS(config_results, "neu_config_results_pooling.rds")

config_results
```
```{r}
pooled_mi <- pool_cluster_mi(config_results, op = "~~")
pooled_mi[, c(
  "lhs", "op", "rhs", "n_clusters", "mi.pooled", "df.pooled", "p.value", "p.value.adj", "median_sepc.all", "n_sepc", "proportion_epc_positive"
)]
```
```{r}
top_candidate <- pooled_mi[1, c("lhs", "op", "rhs")]
top_candidate
```

```{r}
fits <- cluster_lavaan_fits(config_results)
contributing_clusters <- pooled_mi$clusters[[1]]

participant_mi <- do.call(rbind, lapply(contributing_clusters, function(id) {
  fit <- fits[[id]]
  mi <- lavaan::modindices(fit, op = top_candidate$op)
  keep <- mi$lhs == top_candidate$lhs &
    mi$op == top_candidate$op &
    mi$rhs == top_candidate$rhs
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    cluster = id,
    mi = mi$mi[keep][1],
    sepc.all = mi$sepc.all[keep][1]
  )
}))

participant_mi <- participant_mi[is.finite(participant_mi$mi), ]
summary(participant_mi[, c("mi", "sepc.all")])
```
```{r}
old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
participant_id <- as.numeric(as.character(participant_mi$cluster))
plot(
  participant_id, participant_mi$mi,
  xlab = "Participant (cluster ID)", ylab = "Modification index",
  main = paste(top_candidate$lhs, top_candidate$op, top_candidate$rhs),
  type = "h", col = "steelblue"
)
points(participant_id, participant_mi$mi, pch = 1, col = "steelblue")
plot(
  participant_id, participant_mi$sepc.all,
  xlab = "Participant (cluster ID)", ylab = "Standardized EPC",
  type = "h", col = "darkorange"
)
points(participant_id, participant_mi$sepc.all, pch = 1, col = "darkorange")
```
```{r}
par(old_par)
```

```{r}
fits <- cluster_lavaan_fits(config_results)
fits <- fits[vapply(fits, inherits, logical(1), what = "lavaan")]
dat_neu <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(id) {
  participant_data <- as.data.frame(lavaan::lavInspect(fits[[id]], "data"))
  participant_data <- participant_data[, items, drop = FALSE]
  participant_data$participant <- id
  participant_data
}))
rownames(dat_neu) <- NULL

freed_path <- paste(top_candidate$lhs, top_candidate$op, top_candidate$rhs)
model_freed <- paste(
  "fw =~ neu.1 + neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4",
  freed_path,
  sep = "\n"
)

neu_freed <- cluster_fit(
  dat_neu,
  cluster = "participant",
  model = model_freed,
  constraint = "none",
  fit_measures = c("chisq.scaled", "rmsea.robust", "cfi.robust", "srmr"),
  swain_correction = TRUE,
  estimator = "MLR",
  missing = "fiml",
  likelihood = "normal",
  warn = FALSE,
  check.gradient = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
stopifnot(identical(
  paste(top_candidate$lhs, top_candidate$op, top_candidate$rhs),
  "neu.3 ~~ neu.4"
))

common_ids <- intersect(
  as.character(config_results$cluster[config_results$admissible]),
  as.character(neu_freed$cluster[neu_freed$admissible])
)

base_pooled <- pool_cluster_chisq(
  config_results[as.character(config_results$cluster) %in% common_ids, , drop = FALSE],
  chisq_col = "chisq.scaled", use_swain = TRUE
)
freed_pooled <- pool_cluster_chisq(
  neu_freed[as.character(neu_freed$cluster) %in% common_ids, , drop = FALSE],
  chisq_col = "chisq.scaled", use_swain = TRUE
)

rbind(
  data.frame(model = "original", base_pooled),
  data.frame(model = "freed path", freed_pooled)
)
```
